latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release — add music to your Android videos and export with ease.

- Upload Android video clips (up to 500MB) and add background music in the cloud, with no desktop editor required.
- Simple workflow: upload, describe your audio needs, and download 1080p MP4.
- Automatic token management for quick, free access — no registration needed for first 100 credits.
- Supports major formats: MP4, MOV, AVI, WebM (video); MP3, WAV, M4A, AAC (audio).
- Tracks your session state for iterative editing, credits, and export status.
